assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key areas use repository provisional geometry; official polygons are not yet available. All boundary-derived metrics are provisional and must be recomputed when official geometry is published.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios are provisional; no official redline, precise-area, statutory, or ownership claims are made.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Archive facilities record contributions and service status only; no personal trajectories or behavioral profiles are collected. Data classification follows the source registry; honors are granted by human and professional final judgment.
assumptions.impact: Privacy boundaries are hard constraints for all archive scenarios; no monitoring-based public services are proposed.
